Isabella Rodriguez.description: taking a break for lunch (conversing about reviewing interviews on gentrification perspectives and challenges between long-time and newer residents with Isabella Rodriguez and Klaus Mueller.) @ the Ville:Hobbs Cafe:cafe:behind the cafe counter

Maria Lopez.description: conversing about Maria Lopez setting up a meeting between Klaus Mueller and community members at Hobbs Cafe to gather diverse perspectives on gentrification for his research, with the meetup scheduled for Wednesday after Maria's Twitch stream. @ <persona> Klaus Mueller
chat: Maria Lopez
Hi Klaus! I see you're deep in discussions with Isabella. How are things going with your research?
Klaus Mueller
Hi Maria! Things are going well. I'm actually trying to gather more diverse perspectives on gentrification for my study. Have you had a chance to connect me with any new people in the community?
Maria Lopez
Absolutely, Klaus! I'll introduce you to some regulars at Hobbs Cafe who might have unique insights. Let's set up a meeting this week after my Twitch stream to discuss it further.
Klaus Mueller
That sounds great, Maria. Let’s aim for Wednesday after your stream then. I think it will be very helpful to get these different viewpoints.
Maria Lopez
Perfect, I’ll make sure to introduce you to Isabella and a few others at Hobbs Cafe who might have interesting perspectives. Let’s meet around 6pm after my dinner get-together.
Klaus Mueller
Sounds good, Maria. I look forward to hearing from everyone and learning more about their experiences. See you then!
Maria Lopez
Great, I'll make sure everything is set up for our meeting. See you at Hobbs Cafe!
Klaus Mueller
Thanks, Maria. It’s really appreciated. I’ll be there around 6pm sharp.
